SRS AIRBAG — Troubleshooting                                                                                          AB-81

HINT: If the diagnostic code is continuously displayed, perform the following troubleshooting.

1    Check resistance between terminal Tc of center airbag sensor assembly
     and body ground.

[DIAGRAM showing LOCK icon, Center Airbag Sensor Assembly with Tc terminal marked and ground symbol]

P    (1) Turn ignition switch LOCK.
     (2) Disconnect center airbag sensor assembly con-
         nector.

C    Check resistance between terminal Tc of center
     airbag sensor assembly and body ground.

OK   Resistance:   ∞ Ω

NG

OK   Replace center airbag sensor assembly.

Repair or replace harness or connector.
